name: xin-release-tools
description: Building and checking dev releases. `npm test` runs every test that needs no built release; the three that check a built one take its folder as their first argument (see test:candidate).

scripts.test: node test.cjs && node test-build-dev.cjs && node test-configured-python.cjs && node test-diagnostics.cjs && node test-interface.cjs && node test-portable.cjs && node test-release-shell.cjs && node test-setup.cjs
scripts.test:candidate: node -e "console.log('Each needs a built release and the real runtime: node test-packaged.cjs <release> <fixture.json> <out>; node test-analysis-runtime.cjs <release> <input> <out>; node test-inference.cjs <release> <fixture.json> <out>')"
